offering_description.value: Operates full-service casual dining restaurants serving hand-cut steaks, ribs, chicken and made-from-scratch sides to dine-in and takeout guests. Also operates Bubba's 33 sports bar-style restaurants and Jaggers fast-casual restaurants, and licenses Texas Roadhouse restaurants internationally.

primary_services.value: restaurant dining; takeout meals; franchise and licensing support

customer_segment.value: B2C: families and individual diners eating in or ordering takeout

revenue_model.value: product sales: food and beverage sales at company-owned restaurants; licensing or royalties: royalties and fees from franchise and international licensed restaurants

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates restaurants, buying beef and food from suppliers and serving consumers; brand owner: franchisor and licensor of restaurant brands to franchisees and international partners

geography_served.value: global: Restaurants across the US, plus licensed locations in the Middle East, Asia, Mexico and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: Texas Roadhouse steakhouses, Bubba's 33 sports grills and Jaggers fast-casual restaurants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants with dine-in and takeout; partners / resellers: franchisees and international licensees operating restaurants; online: online and app takeout ordering and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, alcohol licensing, labor and wage rules, franchise regulations (health departments, FTC, state liquor authorities)
